stops.name: Parque natural del Peñagolosa
stops.detail: The Peñagolosa Natural Park () () is a Spanish protected natural space situated among the municipalities of Vistabella del Maestratzo, Villahermosa del Río and Chodos, inside the province of Castellón, Valencia. It lies around the massizo of the same name, that occupies an area of 1094.45 ha, clearly insufficient to guarantee the preservation of this mountain massizo, if we have been aware that the area of the madrilel Casa de Campo is 1700 hectares.)
